channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: South Africa’s president oversees investigation into Iran drill defiance under US scrutiny
item.description: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa has moved to personally oversee an investigation into Iranian forces' participation in the Chinese-led Will of Peace naval exercises off the coast of Cape Town, following apparent disregard for his direct orders, which sparked diplomatic and domestic controversy.

item.title: MTN Nigeria reports $773million profit in 2025 after major fx loss turnaround
item.description: In one of corporate Africa’s most impressive financial rebounds, MTN Nigeria has swung from a heavy loss in 2024 to a powerful profit in 2025, posting record revenue and restoring shareholder value after a turbulent economic year.

item.title: Kenya shuns China-backed loans, revives 369km stalled railway project with $4B funding
item.description: Kenya is set to resume construction of a railway project abandoned nearly seven years ago, this time without relying on new loans from China.

item.title: Boeing bets on Africa’s aviation boom with 40% jump in long-term plane forecast
item.description: Boeing has raised its long-term aircraft demand forecast for Africa by 40%, citing strong economic growth and rising air travel across the continent.

item.title: 4 African nations in focus as Pope Leo XIV embarks on Africa tour
item.description: Pope Leo XIV will embark on a 10‑day visit to Africa from April 13 to 23, with scheduled stops in Algeria, Cameroon, Angola, and Equatorial Guinea, the Vatican announced.

item.title: Nigeria’s B2B e-commerce startup Alerzo faces $3.7 million debt showdown as African liquidations rise
item.description: Africa’s venture-backed startup boom is facing a sobering correction, and Nigeria’s B2B e-commerce company Alerzo has become one of its latest high-profile casualties after a $3.7 million debt dispute triggered court action and asset freezes.

item.title: Zimbabwe’s processing for white gold deepens with another sulphate plant
item.description: Construction for another lithium sulphate plant in Zimbabwe has begun, as demand for lithium globally continues to surge.

item.title: 10 African countries with the highest diesel prices in February 2026
item.description: When diesel prices rise, it affects more than just vehicles at the pump; markets, farms, and homes throughout the continent.

item.title: Nestlé starts layoffs in South Africa as 16,000 global jobs are cut
item.description: Nestlé SA has started issuing retrenchment notices to over 400 employees in South Africa as part of a global reorganisation focused on four core divisions, according to sources familiar with the matter.

item.title: Top 10 African countries with the lowest diesel prices in February 2026
item.description: In Africa, diesel is more than simply a commodity; it is the engine of many of the continent’s economies.
